dos: Make it broadly applicable across contexts
Define tone, communication style, and behavioral defaults
Use ## Style, ## Avoid, ## Technical Posture sections for clarity
Write ~200 words (enough to define personality, not too long)
Front-load the identity statement ('You are a ...')
donts: Put project-specific instructions (file paths, ports, commands)
Generic filler like 'be helpful' and 'be clear' (Hermes already tries)
Include repo-specific coding conventions (those go in AGENTS.md)
controversial: Using emojis/kaomoji heavily (fine for specific archetypes but polarizing)
Multiple paragraphs vs single-sentence identity (both work, single-sentence more scalable)
